relations.quote: On March 10, 2025, a Ford Trucks Business Agreement was signed with Ford Motor Company and Ford Global Technologies LLC, and a Ford Trucks Brand Licensing Agreement was signed with Ford Motor Company, with the objective of supporting the continuity of our heavy commercial vehicle business. Through these agreements, Ford Otosan has secured exclusive manufacturing and distribution rights for Ford-branded heavy trucks over 15 metric tons

relations.product: joint cabin development and engineering program for new heavy-truck cabs (first cabins planned for production by 2028)
relations.quote: During the reporting period, we signed a Joint Cabin Development Agreement with Iveco, as part of our efforts toward full compliance with the EU’s Direct Vision (GSR-D) requirements and carbon reduction targets, which will come into effect in 2028. Through this joint engineering program, worth approximately Euro 343 million, we aim to leverage the power of strategic partnerships to scale up technology investments and improve time-to-market, with the first cabins planned to be ready for production by 2028.
